evidence.title: Released the PIXEL ART GUNS - Animated UI asset pack
PIXEL ART GUNS - Animated UI asset pack by JwhnLwnnwn

name: PIXEL ART GUNS - Animated UI asset pack
summary: Pixel-art asset pack of 12 animated gun sprites for game UI, plus crates, projectiles and muzzle flashes, with a demo.
description: Release devlog for PIXEL ART GUNS, a paid itch.io asset pack of 12 pixel-art guns for game UI, each with shooting and reload animations, plus smaller gun versions, 4 military crates, 6 projectiles, 5 spent cases and 10 muzzle flashes. Frames are delivered as sequentially numbered PNGs, drawn in Aseprite and Adobe After Effects with no generative AI, and a demo pack can be downloaded before buying.
contains: 12 animated guns for game UI with shooting and reload animations
4 military crates, 6 projectiles, 5 spent cases, 10 muzzle flashes
individual frames as sequentially numbered PNGs
static frames of the guns without hands
license: commercial use allowed, no redistribution or resale
made with Aseprite and Adobe After Effects; no generative AI
